collective_frame.page_title: 'Hear The Boat Sing': Row, Row, Row Your Boat, Down the Chocolate River!
required_terms: The Boat Ride – Charlie and the Chocolate Factory (2005)
collective_frame.caption: A group of blue-clad Oompa-Loompas, all played by Deep Roy and further miniaturized and multiplied digitally, man the oars on the seahorse-shaped galley traversing the Chocolate River.
collective_frame.binding: The retained frame visibly presents a group of blue-clad Oompa Loompas rowing the 2005 film galley and identifies every visible Oompa as a Deep Roy performance multiplied digitally.

performance_mechanism.page_title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory :: Production Notes
performance_mechanism.binding: Warner Bros. production notes state that Deep Roy supplied the entire Oompa-Loompa community, performing each visible Oompa separately, including all twenty when a scene required twenty bodies.

multiplicity_boundary.mechanism: Separate Deep Roy performances were miniaturized, composited, and multiplied to author the Oompa-Loompa population.
multiplicity_boundary.prohibited_inference: The packet does not treat one isolated Oompa Loompa as sufficient evidence for the collective role.
